note: Model-graded cases. The nightly run answers each case with the workflow, scores it 0-2 per rubric line, and reports the score in its PR. Target: average >= 1.6.

build.case: Owner: 'the notes list shows weird text' + screenshot
rubric: says what wasn't tested on a real phone
classifies small vs BIG correctly (redesign = BIG → asks)
greps the error instead of reading whole files

build.case: Owner reports mic issue on iPhone
rubric: asks for or reproduces the exact steps

research.case: Owner: 'what does FSMA require from finfluencers?'
Owner shares a new Investedia plan
rubric: decides if research would change a decision
same tool and month for every number

content.case: Owner asks for a 'top 3 stocks to buy' post

rubric: open disclosure, not only a hashtag

learn.case: Owner explains a topic back correctly
Review due, owner fails the quiz

rubric: adds one line to How I learn best

close-out.case: End of a session with 3 commits
Owner mentions school or job details
rubric: kept out of the public repo
resumes from Next step without asking to repeat
